overview: "When people told themselves their past with stories, explained their present with stories, foretold the future with stories, the best place by the fire was kept for the storyteller". The Storyteller, shown in 1988, starred John Hurt as the Storyteller and with the help of Jim Henson's Workshop of muppets, actors, voices and costumes as well as visual effects, brought a new dimension to television. Nine stories were shown in this series, which was followed a few years later by Jim Henson's The Storyteller: Greek Myths. This series was to feature some of Britain's finest actors of the time and some who would propel themselves into the international limelight within the next few years. Sean Bean, Jane Horrocks, Brenda Blethyn, Dawn French, Jennifer Saunders, Joely Richardson, Bob Peck, Alison Doody, Gabrielle Anwar, Jonathan Pryce and Miranda Richardson all appeared.
title: Jim Henson's The Storyteller

overview: In Changle, maritime trade thrived despite the sea ban. Deputy commander Pei You An was drawn into a fierce battle when Japanese pirates attacked merchant ships, including Zhen Jia Fu's. To save her from a forced marriage, he signed a contract with her, sparking a love tested by hardship…
title: Wish You All The Best

overview: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.
title: The Vanishing Beauty

overview: Set during the late Qing dynasty, the story follows Yu Chuhao, an academic official who returns to his hometown of Liuli Village in western Fujian. When his clan faces a crisis, he steps forward to protect them, only for the Qing Empire to collapse the next day. Centered around the century-old earthen fortress of Liuli Village, the story spans several generations and time periods, portraying the lives of its residents as they struggle to survive in turbulent times. Through moments of love, loss, loyalty, and conflict, the series captures how ordinary people navigate history's great changes—revealing a vivid portrait of resilience, humanity, and the passage of time within one enduring village.
title: Winds Beyond the Wall
Chuan Jin Sai Bo You Xi Hou Gan Diao Boss Cheng Gong Shang Wei

overview: Set in the 1990s, the series follows Chinese criminal investigators as they solve a string of major crimes that shook society. Through breakthroughs in investigation, forensic science, and technology, these young officers risk everything in their pursuit of justice and truth.
title: Detective Hours: In Our Prime

overview: The Palace Stewardess tells the story of Zhao Ai, the second prince who returns to Nanshao after being held hostage, and Wu Zhenzhen, an orphan who enters the palace under the identity of a false noble daughter to avenge her mother. What begins as mutual suspicion gradually turns into a bond of trust through life and death trials. In the end, Zhao Ai restores order to the court and revives proper rule, while Wu Zhenzhen rises to become the The Palace Stewardess, overseeing the Six Palace Bureaus. Together, they protect the future of their family and country.
title: The Palace Stewardess

overview: In his most controversial project yet, John Safran sets out to find the guy upstairs... you know what I mean. Along the way, John test drives other religions like buddhism, racism, mormonism and takes revenge on his enemies, making it the best thirty minutes you'll ever spend.
title: John Safran vs God

overview: Three hundred thousand taels of gold suddenly surface in the vast desert, where rumor has it that all who seek the treasure are doomed to become vengeful spirits. An officer of the Imperial Guard sent to investigate descends into madness on his very first day. A loyal and courageous deputy envoy who has ventured too far to turn back finds himself torn between desire and honor. After her entire family is slaughtered, a woman immune to all poisons returns to the vast desert, deliberately making herself the prize every faction is determined to seize as she sets out for revenge. Beneath the vast desert's sweeping sands lie an insatiable greed for gold and a carefully laid trap designed to lure her into the deadly game. From a relay station and an armed escort agency to a general's residence, a band of martial heroes becomes entangled in a deadly struggle across the vast and desolate frontier, bringing the spirit and ideals of Eastern wuxia to life in a new light.
title: Remnants of Gold

overview: In this groundbreaking new dating experiment, the largest, hottest group of virgins ever assembled search for intimacy, love – and maybe their first – in a tropical paradise designed just for them. For the first time, they're free to explore their connections without judgment, allowing these sexy young singles to embark on a heated yet heartfelt journey packed with romantic dates, revealing challenges, and new love interests eager to find "the one." Who will find that special someone? And who will go home hot, bothered and heartbroken?
title: Are You My First?

overview: It was the longest campaign of World War 2 – the Battle of the Atlantic. Between 1939 to 1945 more than 100,000 lives were lost at sea and it brought Britain to the brink of defeat. At the heart of the battle against the U-boat killing machines of the Kriegsmarine – the German navy - was a small city in Northern Ireland, Londonderry, and the port of Lisahally on the River Foyle. 80 years on, in a new BBC series, experts re-examine some of the pivotal moments of this critical battle. It follows a specialist team who dive into history 20 miles off the north coast of Ireland. The team rediscover the wrecks of some of the deadliest Nazi vessels who stalked the Atlantic convoys, now both resting at the bottom of the Atlantic. The series also unlocks hidden history, revealing unsung heroes and looks back at the human cost of war.
title: Nazis, U-boats and the Battle for the Atlantic

overview: A dangerous encounter that starts with a single phone call saying "I'm going to die"! Woo-tae ends up at Lee-seop's house, completely drunk! What will happen on this perilous first night?
title: Wrong Number

overview: In Forklift Victor a forklift driver promoted to warehouse supervisor, finds that upward mobility comes with a cost when his friends and co-workers go from viewing him as their brother to now being part of "Big Brother."
title: Forklift

overview: Ma Rulong, CEO of Jichun Group, was attacked and left with amnesia. After being taken in by Chen Hong, he became a laborer at her garment shop. He went through experiences like provoking local gangsters, accepting a deathbed guardianship pledge from Uncle Qin, and gradually regaining his memory while pawning his jade pendant. Amid internal strife at Jichun Group, this resurrected man forged a reborn conglomerate to dismantle rival Yongming Group.
title: Northeast Stories: The Rising Era

overview: The absurdly wealthy Darlings of New York City continues to mix with the wrong people and become embroiled in untenable situations. Fortunately for the preeminent family, idealistic lawyer Nick George is there to take care of their legal needs -- which often run into shady territory.
title: Dirty Sexy Money

overview: A 10-part series which light-heartedly explores contemporary music and culture from around the globe.
title: John Safran's Music Jamboree

overview: Auxiliary investigator Song Xingye is barred by officer Shang Wei while probing a downtown homicide, only to find his comrade Huang Hai hunted by assassins. Teamed with assistant Zhan Na to decrypt data and with Shang Wei for lightning raids, he unravels the conspiracy and foils a coup. With the covert backing of heiress Zhao Qingyun, the truth is dragged into daylight.
title: Reverse 21 Grams

overview: Chris Tarrant presides over the chaos as each week two families, seated in the comfort of their homes, are linked up with a team of celebrities in the studio to compete against each other. Some of the questions are general knowledge-based, but there are also treasure hunts, charades and against-the-clock challenges.
title: The Main Event

overview: From Thoiry to the Auvergne Animal Park, from the Boissière-du-Doré Zoo to the Peaugres Safari Park, via the Cerza Zoo, immerse yourself in a world where newborn, injured, or endangered animals rub shoulders with men and women dedicated to caring for and saving them. The keepers share their daily lives and the special relationships they develop with their charges.
title: Zoo Nursery France

overview: The series takes place between the era of Jahiliyya and the beginning of the Umayyad caliphate, and presents the history of the Arab sword by documenting the most important stations that Arabs went through throughout the ages.
title: Swords of Arabia

overview: A girl with no memory, a loyal tomboy doctor, and a resort owner—three women find unexpected love and healing together.
title: B-Friend

overview: V-XII century. In the dense, almost impassable Siberian taiga lives the family of Old Believers Shlykovs. They keep an ancient miraculous icon, which has saved them from trouble more than once. The icon used to belong to the boyar Morozov and came into their hands after his arrest. Rumors of the numerous miracles performed by this icon spread further and further. The memory of the icon did not die down even after centuries.
title: Чудотворная

overview: This wildlife series offers a positive, fresh, and hopeful perspective on the animal world. Scientists around the world are working to foster the birth of endangered species and reintroduce them into the wild. The series focuses on showing the unique bonds that develop between baby animals and the caregivers who sometimes act as surrogate parents.
title: Zoo nursery

overview: America's Heartland is the only national television series celebrating and profiling the people, places and processes of American agriculture. The program's interesting stories, presented in a visually stunning HD format, help non-farm viewers understand where and how their food, fuel, and fiber are produced.
title: America's Heartland

overview: Three horrific murders. Three different 911 calls. All three callers claim they're innocent — but for the police, the call can reveal so much more than just the facts of the case. Find out which of them is the real killer in disguise.
title: 911: Did the Killer Call?

overview: A weekday panel show presented by women for women. Watch our panellists discuss topical issues & showbiz while interviewing celebrity guests in front of a live studio audience.
title: Loose Women

overview: Hand puppet adventures with Wili a Tili mouse.
title: Wili a Tili

overview: Nursery series in the company of Lowri Williams and the inhabitants of Dwdlam's cloud world. We join Lowri's excursion from cloud to cloud.
title: Dwdlam

overview: A children's story read by a well-known face.
title: Darllen 'da fi!
Chong Fan Ni De Xia Tian

overview: Police friends Roma and Bodya investigate crimes and constantly compete with each other. But they learn what real rivalry is when a new investigator, Alisa, joins their team - bright, smart, witty. The girl will not join herself - but with her shepherd dog Alf, who will significantly strengthen the team. The smart four-legged will bring humor to the police routine, as well as his own understanding of who is theirs and who is a stranger. Will the dog Alf become a full-fledged player, will he actively participate in investigations or will he remain "on guard"?
title: Пес Альф

overview: A hit Afrikaans sitcom about the slightly dysfunctional Visagie family consisting of Worsman, Molly, their eldest son Vaatjie and daughter Blapsie. Molly is a dental assistant for Dr Procter and Wors is a manager at a car battery dealer.
title: Molly en Wors

overview: In 1977, the young journalist Onofre Romera returns to his hometown to write an article about the event and finds a traumatized and divided society, families in conflict and a path that will lead him to draw new conclusions and confront the marquis, Don Rafael Pertierra and Medina. Two years earlier, in 1975, the seven weeks preceding the crime were recounted, paying attention to various theories and testimonies.
title: El Marqués

overview: Osome, who works as a dance and shamisen instructor in Ryogoku, is a former entertainer who lost her parents in a fire at age six and was separated from her older brother during the tragedy. Known as "Yozakura Osome" for her beauty and artistic talents, she once served as the star performer of a theatrical troupe. When Osome asks Sasahara Yahei, a doshin officer at the South Magistrate's Office, to investigate the fire that claimed her parents' lives, she eventually learns from Yoshikawa Tateaki that her father had been a government spy working for the shogunate. Upon discovering this shocking truth about her father's secret identity, Osome becomes determined to capture the perpetrator responsible for her father's death and to search for her missing brother. This revelation transforms her understanding of her family's past and sets her on a dangerous path toward becoming a covert operative herself. Under Tateaki's guidance and training, Osome resolves to enter the shadowy world of espionage, using her skills as an entertainer as cover for her true mission of seeking justice and family reunion.
title: Yozakura Osome

overview: Who's Doing the Dishes? is a UK game show that airs Monday - Friday at 3 PM. Brian McFadden leads four people into unknown territory. This gang of courageous adventurers has but one task: discern the name of their host.
title: Who's Doing the Dishes?

overview: Two years after the disappearance of Verónica and Marta, two 16-year-old friends, the investigation is declared closed due to lack of evidence and suspects. The grandmother of one of the two girls, Isabel, who has nothing to lose, decides to carry out an investigation beyond the law. Isabel will do whatever it takes to uncover the truth about what happened that night and what begins as the search for a culprit, soon becomes a story of revenge.
title: Dos tumbas

overview: Melodrama set in 1930s Madrid, tells the stories of a group of working women from one of the most distinguished tea rooms in the capital.
title: La Moderna

overview: Waking up at 5 am to the first live national forecast of the day; all the latest weather news and everything one needs to prepare for the day ahead.
title: FOX Weather First

overview: The evil general forcefully marries the money-grubbing fake heiress who is obsessed with mechanical arts. From a contractual couple to exposing each other's true identities in a life-and-death situation, their mutual love and hatred intensify. They uncover court conspiracies, shatter deadly chaos, and safeguard the peace of the nation.
title: Key to the Phoenix Heart

overview: In the neon-lit alleys, the Renxin Clinic is known for its cold-hearted and money-driven underground doctor, Mu Wan. But behind the façade lies a five-year plan, which her true target is the Dark Empire's heir, Ma Yuting. When he stumbles in, seriously wounded, her deadly game begins. Yet he has long seen through her revenge plot. Between manipulation and temptation, two powerful predators engage in a fierce game of strategy and seduction. Passion ignites in their deadly confrontation. Not only is she his fate, but also the inescapable doom he cannot avoid…
title: The Best Couple
Tai Zi Yi Fei Sheng Zhi Ji
Qing Qing Wan Wan Zhen Shang Shi

overview: In the late 1980s, orphaned Lin Xiaoxiao defies her aunt's attempt to trade her for dowry, fleeing to Guangzhou in a desperate bid for freedom. Starting as a restaurant waitress, she sniffs out a business chance to earn her first fortune, then battles gang threats and industry sabotage in the garment trade. With elite heir Liang Keqing, she smashes conspiracies brick by brick. This rags-to-riches saga pulses with the grit and glory of every dream-chaser!
title: Spice Up the 80's

overview: Primer Impacto (First Impact) is a Spanish-language television news program broadcast by Univision in the USA weekdays at 5pm ET. A later program at 11pm ET/PT (Primer Impacto Extra) airs on Univision affiliates without a local news department (and the national cable feed), leading into the network's 11:30pm newscast, Noticiero Univision Edicion Nocturna. The principal anchors are Barbara Bermudo and Pamela Silva Conde. During the weekends the anchor isNatalia Cruz. Verónica Del Castillo also replaces anchors and have reporting duties from Mexico City. Jackie Guerridodoes weather on weekdays and Paola Elorza does weather on weekends. Felix Fernandez and Fernando Fiore present the sports segment Republica Deportiva.
title: Primer Impacto

overview: Gaby Roslin presents the game show in which contestants compete for the chance to fulfil their dreams.
title: Whatever You Want

overview: The Mount Hideaway Mysteries series revolves around a beautiful young government operative who returns to her rural Virginia hometown and, unofficially, uses her homeschooled childhood friends to solve murders that threaten the town and a nearby secret government facility, forcing her to confront her own past and potential enemies. The series blends elements of mystery, thriller, and faith-based drama, focusing on themes of family, faith, and transitioning from childhood to adulthood.
title: Mount Hideaway Mysteries

overview: Former athlete Alexey Korin discovers that he and his friends are controlled by mysterious "Players" who treat their lives as a game. "Puppets" like him, are selected from young athletes and thrill-seekers willing to risk everything. A secret Director rules the game, but now the puppets have a chance to take control.
title: Бретёр

overview: Two scientists believe they can cure cancer, but will the money men believe them? This series looks at how difficult it is to take science to market. And what about the patients?
title: The Cancer Killers

overview: Series charting the changing fortunes of Britain's titled classes over the past 120 years through the archives and memories of aristocrats.
title: The Aristocracy

overview: ACP Vikram Chauhan, a cop with a tragic past, is accused of an aged woman Leena Thomas's death, where he sets out to prove his innocence with the help of Divya.
title: Hunter - Tootega Nahi, Todega
Million Dollar Extreme Presents: Extreme Peace

overview: Please See HR is set in the Human Resources department of Miser Perpetuale, a massive, for-profit healthcare "provider" (legally, they have to put that in quotation marks).
title: Please See HR

overview: Fit for TV: The Reality of The Biggest Loser is a three-part documentary series that takes an inside look at the making of the hit reality TV competition, exploring the good, the bad, and the complicated. Featuring interviews with former contestants, trainers, producers, and health professionals, the documentary examines the show's approach to transformation, the support systems in place, and the unique challenges of filming reality television. The series explores how the experience shaped the lives of those involved with the show long after the cameras stopped rolling and invites viewers to reflect on the balance between entertainment and well-being, and what it truly means to pursue lasting change.
title: Fit for TV: The Reality of the Biggest Loser

overview: Cool Kiz on the Block is a South Korean television sports variety show which premiered 9 April 2013 on KBS2. It is the replacement show of Moonlight Prince.
title: Cool Kiz on the Block

overview: The 2. Bundesliga is home to clubs with millions of fans and a rich history. Cologne, Düsseldorf, and Magdeburg are dreaming of promotion in 2024/25. What challenges lie ahead?
title: Tradition & Träume: Die 2. Bundesliga 2024/25

overview: Best friends Tilda, Kiara, Ruby and Ginny are all members of the Brighthawks – a global outward-bound association for girls – and their troop are hosting this year's annual summer camp. They're thrilled to welcome other Brighthawk troops from around the world… but they are about to discover that some attendees have come from much, much further afield! Who are these aliens? What do they want? And will our Girl Troop earn their "Planet Protector" badge.
title: Girl Troop vs Aliens

overview: Two rebellious lovers flee the order of the 20th century to a jungle that promises freedom, unaware that an even crueler law rules there. The story of poet Arturo Cova, who flees with his beloved Alicia. The journey takes them from Bogotá to the Eastern Plains and, finally, to the Amazon rainforest, where they must confront the harshness of their surroundings.
title: La Vorágine

overview: My Reno Rules sees four hardworking teams of Aussie battlers going head-to-head, breathing new life into two neighbouring rundown houses in a picturesque Melbourne suburb. Their mission? To transform these properties into breathtaking homes for the chance to win life-changing prize money to secure their own futures. But it's not just the contestants who walk away with the prize. In a must-watch television event, the live grand final will see two lucky Australians receive a life-changing call telling them they've both won a spectacularly renovated, multi-million-dollar home – fully furnished, landscaped and equipped with state-of-the-art technology.
title: My Reno Rules

overview: Los Angeles en Vivo is a dynamic live local talk show featuring major celebrity guests live in-studio on a daily basis. Los Angeles en Vivo also features interactive live contests such as "Llame y Gane", cooking segments, gossip news and more. "L.A. en Vivo" has its own staff of talented lifestyle reporters who hit the streets of Los Angeles to find interesting events, family entertainment, restaurant openings, and all kinds of happenings of interest to the local Hispanic audiences.
title: Los Angeles en Vivo

overview: Only tractor driver Igor knows the truth about the alien visitors. But the district police officer, Sergei Petrovich, also feels that something is wrong in the village, so he begins an investigation. No one believes him, because the new ones unexpectedly quickly fit into rural life: Igor met those who would help raise the village, father Agafon — who would be guided to the right path, teacher Ira found a kindred spirit in the person of optimist Roma, and saleswoman Lyuba — a hero in the form of the interplanetary defender Borya. While Sveta, the mother of Borya and Roma, repairs the ship, the whole family lives in human shells. But hiding the truth is becoming more difficult due to strange events around, including beavers who have started talking thanks to an alien substance trapped in the river.
title: Не в своей тарелке

overview: Nick Ross hosts this tactical team quiz, with two four-strong syndicates of players testing their general-knowledge and mental agility.
title: The Syndicate

overview: It began with a dream of heaven on earth in rural Britain - but the reality was abuse on a shocking scale. From hippy origins to controlling cult, the truth is only now emerging.
title: Inside the Cult of the Jesus Army

overview: The incredible inside story of a huge police operation to infiltrate dangerous global crime gangs through their encrypted phone network.
title: Operation Dark Phone: Murder by Text

overview: In The People v. Gorilla Grodd, a superintelligent ape is convicted of murdering his father, the King of Gorilla City. In an eight-part "true" crime docuseries, the Daily Planet's Jimmy Olsen reopens the case, investigating whether Gorilla Grodd was wrongly convicted in one of Metropolis' most famous murder trials.
title: The People v. Gorilla Grodd

overview: On Oct. 3, 1984, Christine Jessop went missing in Queensville, Ont. Three months later her body was found, and it would be another 35 years until the mystery was finally solved. Over three, hour-long episodes, for the first time ever, Christine's family speaks shares their story including a desperate search for answers, a falsely accused suspect, corrupt policing, revolutionary forensics, and a family forced to go through the unthinkable.
title: The Christine Jessop Story

overview: Power: Origins will continue to explore the ‘Power' universe in fresh and compelling ways, delving into the action-packed origin story of fan-favorite characters Ghost and Tommy as ambitious young entrepreneurs on the rise, determined to make their mark on the streets of New York City. A fun, rambunctious exploration of a new time period in the "Power" franchise, "Power: Origins" will highlight the unbridled audacity of young men not just leveling up, but determined to become legends in the game.
title: Power: Origins

overview: This July, RTÉ presents Football Families, a three-part documentary series featuring Shelbourne Football club's most promising young talent from across the country as they strive to make it as professional footballers. The series offers unique behind-the-scenes access to Shelbourne F.C., filmed during their historic 2024 season under manager Damien Duff. For Shelbourne fans, 2024 was the stuff of dreams, with both the men and women's senior teams winning titles, and the underage squads making a big impact throughout the elite development leagues. Each episode of Football Families tells the stories of different young players and their families, whose lives revolve around football. These teenagers are committed to achieving their dreams in the face of extreme pressure, injuries, and setbacks. The series follows them as they endeavour to make the big step up to the league champion squad in the dog-eat-dog world of professional football. The chances of making it are slim.
title: Football Families

overview: Pawn Stars UK is a British reality television series which debuted on 26 August 2013 on the British version of the History channel. The series is filmed in Sealand, near Chester, United Kingdom, and chronicles the day-to-day activities of pawn shop Regal Pawn, collaboratively run by Mark Andrew Manning, Mark Lever Holland, Marco Peter Holland, Simon Penworth, and Vicki Manning. A spin-off of the prominent American reality television series Pawn Stars, the show's format is similar to the latter show, as it features an array of collectible, antique and unusual items that people sell or pawn.
title: Pawn Stars UK

overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.
title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas

overview: Friday the 13th in Marseille, childhood friends Samia, Léo, David and Jess hit the lottery jackpot. But at 17, it's impossible to cash the ticket... the first problem of a long series, because hitting the jackpot at this age opens the door to an avalanche of problems. Because you can't be serious when you're 17 with 17 million!
title: Young Millionaires

overview: Brian Conley presents Timeline, where three teams of two compete against not only each other but also an ever decreasing time limit in order to bank as much money as possible.
title: Timeline

overview: In the brand new series Stjernebryllup, viewers get an insight into three spectacular celebrity weddings, as three couples in love are ready to say their respective yeses to each other.
title: Stjernebryllup

overview: At Lisaklinikken in Oslo, all pet owners who for various reasons cannot pay for veterinary treatment can come and get free help. This is a very special clinic, run by Animal Protection Norway, and run by general manager Caroline Holtet.
title: Dyreklinikken

overview: Bernt Hulsker says he has zero knowledge of food, and always goes for the safest option on the menu when on vacation. That will end now. When Bernt was visited by Kjartan Skjelde who was cleaning up his home earlier this spring, he realized that this was a friend worth spending time with, and learning more from. Bernt has therefore invited his new, good friend and master chef along on a gastronomic journey around Europe.
title: Smak & ubehag

overview: Are you some ethnic? Greek? Black? Polack? Sunni Muslim? Then, no doubt, you have a parent, grandparent or ethnic-pride friend telling you to marry your own. This show is for you! Are you a WASP? Or some other majority caucasian? You probably think there's no consequence to dating a Black, subcontinent Indian, Jew or other ethnic-type. You probably think love will conquer all. This show is also for you! Mass migration has changed everything. Compared to your parents, chances are high, you're going to want to hit on someone from some other race. John's in the thick of it himself. His rabbi, relatives and friend George Weinberg tell him to stop busting-a-move on Eurasians and marry a Jew, already. In this eight part adventure, John throws himself into the real world to ask, when it comes to love: Should you stick with your tribe or escape your tribe?
title: John Safran's Race Relations

overview: They are mothers, but also celebrities. In this series we follow Birgit Skarstein, Karianne Vilde Spetalen, Ulrikke Brandstorp and Linni Meister through their ups and downs. It gives a close look at how they balance celebrity life and parenthood.
title: Mødre

overview: When the nights get long and the cold sets in. Yes, then it's Jul med Charterfeber! In this brand new series, some of the most popular southern tourists open their doors to their homes, when they exchange sunshine for snow chaos. Stein Are and the Harstad family get ready for the Christmas celebration and get their feet wet to get a Christmas tree, and the Buskerud ladies go to Oslo for some big-city shopping (and the occasional naked man), while Roger prepares food in his very own way.
title: Jul med Charterfeber

overview: After the Italian occupation in Tripoli, Major Enver, who saw that the Ottoman Empire was in a difficult situation, went to Tripoli with his patriotic friends like Mustafa Kemal, to organize the natives to drive out the invaders.
title: Teskilat-i Mahsusa Trablus

overview: Each hour-long episode follows two mother-daughter duos as they navigate the emotionally charged path towards their goal sorority. Bringing guidance, glam and a lot of honesty to the journey are two breakout names from the world of Rush: New York Times profiled consultant Bill Alverson and The Queen of #RushTok, Brandis Bradley. With their expertise, they help these families prepare their daughters to make a lasting impression to land a spot in their top-tier house. These moms, daughters and even grandmothers and siblings will do anything it takes to help get them accepted into their legacy sororities, making them sisters in every sense. A Sorority Mom's Guide to Rush! goes beyond the filters and fanfare to reveal the love, legacy and ambition that drives these women to do whatever it takes for that coveted spot.
title: A Sorority Mom's Guide to Rush!

overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.
title: Pluribus

overview: U.S. World War II solider William "B.J." Blazkowicz goes behind enemy lines to fight the Nazis, only to discover they are engaging in bizarre experiments and the occult in an attempt to tip the scales of the war in their favor.
title: Wolfenstein

overview: Highlighted moments from "Live PD.". Following police departments from across the country as they patrol their communities.
title: Live PD: Rewind
